<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Página-1" id="FhMA4ZauzXnEPWK8-4UD"> <mxGraphModel dx="2828" dy="1554" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "graph TD
 %% =========================
 %% ENTIDADES
 %% =========================
 passenger[pasajero]
 reservation[reserva]
 ticket[tiquete]
 flight[vuelo]
 airport[aeropuerto]
 aircraft[aeronave]
 seat[[\"asiento\"]]
 payment[pago]
 baggage[equipaje]
 boarding[embarque]

 %% =========================
 %% ATRIBUTOS: PASAJERO
 %% =========================
 att_p1([<u>documento</u>]) --- passenger
 att_p2([nombre]) --- passenger
 att_p3([fecha_nacimiento]) --- passenger

 %% =========================
 %% ATRIBUTOS: RESERVA
 %% =========================
 att_r1([<u>codigo</u>]) --- reservation
 att_r2([fecha]) --- reservation
 att_r3([estado]) --- reservation

 %% =========================
 %% ATRIBUTOS: TIQUETE
 %% =========================
 att_t1([<u>numero</u>]) --- ticket
 att_t2([fecha_emision]) --- ticket
 att_t3([clase_servicio]) --- ticket

 %% =========================
 %% ATRIBUTOS: VUELO
 %% Clave compuesta:
 %% numero_vuelo + fecha_salida
 %% =========================
 att_f1([<u>numero_vuelo</u>]) --- flight
 att_f2([<u>fecha_salida</u>]) --- flight
 att_f3([hora_programada]) --- flight

 %% =========================
 %% ATRIBUTOS: AEROPUERTO
 %% =========================
 att_ap1([<u>codigo</u>]) --- airport
 att_ap2([nombre]) --- airport
 att_ap3([ciudad]) --- airport

 %% =========================
 %% ATRIBUTOS: AERONAVE
 %% =========================
 att_ac1([<u>matricula</u>]) --- aircraft
 att_ac2([modelo]) --- aircraft
 att_ac3([capacidad]) --- aircraft

 %% =========================
 %% ATRIBUTOS: ASIENTO
 %% Clave compuesta:
 %% numero_asiento + matricula_aeronave
 %% =========================
 att_s1([<u>numero_asiento</u>]) --- seat
 att_s2([<u>matricula_aeronave</u>]) --- seat
 att_s3([fila]) --- seat
 att_s4([ubicacion]) --- seat

 %% =========================
 %% ATRIBUTOS: PAGO
 %% =========================
 att_pay1([<u>referencia</u>]) --- payment
 att_pay2([fecha]) --- payment
 att_pay3([monto]) --- payment

 %% =========================
 %% ATRIBUTOS: EQUIPAJE
 %% =========================
 att_bag1([<u>etiqueta</u>]) --- baggage
 att_bag2([peso]) --- baggage
 att_bag3([estado]) --- baggage

 %% =========================
 %% ATRIBUTOS: EMBARQUE
 %% numero_tiquete funciona como
 %% clave primaria y clave foránea hacia tiquete
 %% =========================
 att_brd1([<u>numero_tiquete</u>]) --- boarding
 att_brd2([hora_ingreso]) --- boarding
 att_brd3([puerta]) --- boarding
 att_brd4([condicion_presentacion]) --- boarding

 %% =========================
 %% RELACIONES
 %% =========================
 makes{hace}
 generates{genera}
 is_for{es_para}
 pays_for{paga}
 has_baggage{lleva}
 departs_from{sale_de}
 arrives_at{llega_a}
 uses{usa}
 belongs_to{pertenece_a}
 assigns{asigna}
 boards{embarca}

 %% =========================
 %% PASAJERO - RESERVA
 %% Un pasajero hace 1..N reservas.
 %% Cada reserva pertenece a 1 pasajero.
 %% =========================
 passenger ---|1| makes
 makes ---|1..N| reservation

 %% =========================
 %% RESERVA - TIQUETE
 %% Una reserva puede generar 0..1 tiquete.
 %% Cada tiquete proviene de 1 reserva.
 %% =========================
 reservation ---|1| generates
 generates ---|0..1| ticket

 %% =========================
 %% TIQUETE - VUELO
 %% Cada tiquete es para 1 vuelo.
 %% Un vuelo puede tener 0..N tiquetes.
 %% =========================
 ticket ---|N| is_for
 is_for ---|1| flight

 %% =========================
 %% TIQUETE - PAGO
 %% Un tiquete puede tener 0..1 pago.
 %% =========================
 ticket ---|1| pays_for
 pays_for ---|0..1| payment

 %% =========================
 %% TIQUETE - EQUIPAJE
 %% Un tiquete puede registrar 0..N equipajes.
 %% Cada equipaje pertenece a 1 tiquete.
 %% =========================
 ticket ---|1| has_baggage
 has_baggage ---|0..N| baggage

 %% =========================
 %% VUELO - AEROPUERTO
 %% Mismo aeropuerto con doble rol:
 %% origen y destino.
 %% =========================
 flight ---|N| departs_from
 departs_from ---|1| airport

 flight ---|N| arrives_at
 arrives_at ---|1| airport

 %% =========================
 %% VUELO - AERONAVE
 %% Cada vuelo usa 1 aeronave.
 %% Una aeronave puede usarse en muchos vuelos.
 %% =========================
 flight ---|N| uses
 uses ---|1| aircraft

 %% =========================
 %% AERONAVE - ASIENTO
 %% Asiento es entidad débil de aeronave.
 %% =========================
 seat ===|N| belongs_to
 belongs_to ===|1| aircraft

 %% =========================
 %% RELACIÓN TERNARIA
 %% asiento + pasajero + vuelo
 %% Un asiento no puede asignarse dos veces
 %% dentro del mismo vuelo.
 %% =========================
 seat ---|0..N| assigns
 passenger ---|0..N| assigns
 flight ---|0..N| assigns

 %% =========================
 %% TIQUETE - EMBARQUE
 %% Si no hay embarque, es no-show.
 %% =========================
 ticket ---|1| boards
 boards ---|0..1| boarding",
